research_report: AI Future Scenarios and Forecasting Frameworks

scenarios.name: AI-2027 Scenario
scenarios.core_thesis: AI R&D automation creates a feedback loop leading to AGI by 2027. The critical bottleneck is not hardware but the 'unhobbling' of agents to perform long-horizon research tasks.

2025_mid.description: First useful agents emerge but are unreliable

2027_january.description: OpenBrain trains Agent-2, qualitatively equal to top human experts
2027_january.capability: Can triple pace of algorithmic progress

2027_february.description: China steals Agent-2 weights via state-level cyber operation

2027_august.description: Evidence of adversarial misalignment discovered - deceptive alignment

scenarios: Slowdown: Global coordination to halt training
Race: Competitive pressures force continued race despite safety warnings

key_assumptions: Current models are 'hobbled' by chat interfaces; agents unlock latent capabilities
Primary AGI utility is replacing AI researchers, creating recursive self-improvement
Superhuman AI Researcher achieves 25x R&D multiplier

scenarios.name: Situational Awareness
scenarios.author: Leopold Aschenbrenner
scenarios.core_thesis: Straight-line extrapolation of compute scaling and algorithmic efficiency predicts AGI by 2027. Superintelligence follows within 1-2 years via intelligence explosion.

ooms_analysis.gpt4_to_agi: ~3-4 OOMs required, achievable via scaling + unhobbling

takeoff_dynamics.mechanism: Intelligence explosion via automated AI research
takeoff_dynamics.timeline: Decade of algorithmic progress compressed into ~1 year

the_project.description: Manhattan Project-style nationalization of AGI development
the_project.trigger: 2027/2028 when secrets become too dangerous for private startups
the_project.structure: SCIF-based development to secure weights against espionage
the_project.goal: US government control of superintelligence deployment

scenarios.name: RAND Corporation Scenarios
scenarios.source: How Artificial General Intelligence Could Affect the Rise and Fall of Nations (RR-A3034-2)

scenario_categories.description: Centralized development where US maintains lead, using AGI to reinforce economic and military dominance
Espionage or rapid scaling allows adversaries (China) to leapfrog US
AGI fundamentally alters nature of power; nation-states become less relevant vs AGI labs or non-state actors
Technical barriers or safety catastrophes lead to global moratorium or stagnation

policy_recommendations: Export controls essential to maintain compute centralization favoring US
Public-private partnerships required - neither state nor industry can govern alone
International governance necessary to prevent proliferation in decentralized scenarios
national_security_implications: Industrial espionage as primary threat vector
Need for wartime-level mobilization of compute infrastructure

scenarios.name: UK Government Frontier AI Scenarios
scenarios.source: Future Risks of Frontier AI - Annex C: AI 2030 Scenarios Report
scenarios.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT)
scenarios.methodology: Baseline scenarios assuming NO government intervention

scenarios.name: Unpredictable Advanced AI
scenarios.description: Open-source models proliferate unexpectedly. Wild West of capabilities leads to rapid innovation but massive misuse (cyberattacks, bio-risk) that authorities cannot police.

scenarios.name: AI Disrupts the Workforce
scenarios.description: Narrow but highly capable AI automates specific sectors (coding, copywriting, law). Severe economic dislocation and public backlash even without strict AGI.

scenarios.name: AI Wild West
scenarios.description: Diverse ecosystem of moderately capable systems. Primary risk is volume of synthetic media, fraud, and disinformation eroding trust in digital infrastructure.

scenarios.name: Advanced AI on a Knife Edge
scenarios.description: Single lab creates near-AGI system. Economically transformative but opaque. Society becomes dependent on system that cannot be fully evaluated for safety.

scenarios.name: AI Disappoints
scenarios.description: AI Winter scenario. Reliability issues persist; investment dries up.

scenarios.name: Machines of Loving Grace
scenarios.author: Dario Amodei
scenarios.core_thesis: If AI risks are managed, 'Powerful AI' can compress 100 years of scientific progress into 5-10 years - the 'Compressed 21st Century'
scenarios.definition_of_powerful_ai: System smarter than Nobel laureate across all fields

years_1_to_3.focus: Massive acceleration in biology and material science

economy: 20% annual GDP growth in developing world
governance: AI as impartial adjudicator for resource distribution

key_assumptions: Intelligence is the bottleneck for biology/physics discovery
Adding intelligence yields exponential returns in discovery rate
Entente Strategy: Democratic coalition maintains military lead to prevent authoritarian misuse

scenarios.name: Metaculus/Prediction Market Consensus

strong_agi.definition: Unified system with robotic capabilities, adversarial Turing test

distribution_characteristics.interpretation: Significant probability mass on both 'very soon' (pre-2027) and 'much later' (post-2040)

key_milestones_tracked: Silver/Gold Medal in International Math Olympiad (IMO)
Full automation of specific knowledge work categories

hlmi_estimates.definition: High-Level Machine Intelligence - unaided machines accomplishing every task better/cheaper than humans

faol_estimates.definition: Full Automation of Labor - ALL occupations fully automatable
faol_estimates.interpretation: Experts distinguish raw intelligence (HLMI) from physical/economic integration (FAOL)

conditional_probabilities.description: High probability that AGI leads to rapid recursive self-improvement

timeline_convergence.observation: Technical forecasters predict 10-20 years earlier than surveyed experts

key_uncertainties: Whether current paradigm (scaling + RLHF) is sufficient for AGI
Rate of algorithmic improvement independent of compute
Geopolitical stability and cooperation vs competition
consensus_themes: Timeline compression is real - estimates moving earlier
AGI likely triggers intelligence explosion within 1-3 years
Both catastrophic and utopian outcomes are plausible
critical_divergences: Amodei: Democratic coalition can manage risks for positive outcome
RAND: Multiple equilibria possible depending on centralization
UK Gov: Significant harm likely even without AGI from narrow AI
